					Welcome toCoral Jubail Hotel
				
										
					Experience the Luxury & Comfort of 4 Star Coral Hotel in Jubail
With its unique mix of luxury and comfort, Coral Jubail Hotel provides exceptional hospitality to business and leisure travellers alike.
A tranquil oasis in the bustling city of Jubail, the hotel offers easy access to the city's attractions and business districts, and is located 70 kms from King Fahd International Airport in Dammam.
Book your stay at Coral Jubail Hotel online where you will find the best hotel rates, or call +966 50 923 9480.

5 / 5 Rating
				Coral Hotel Jubail, outstanding.
This is the second time I have been to this hotel and it has been an absolute pleasure both times, I cannot recommend it enough.
I am here on work so I do need the rest time after a hectic shift, the bed was perfect, the pillows let me wake up feeling refreshed.
The staff have been fantastic, always smiling, always polite and very helpful. It is almost as though it is a family run hotel. I have had to extend my stay several times due to work extensions and it has never been an issue, it was taken care of immediately which sent my mind completely at ease. I'll be back again before the end of the year and I will definitely be checking in to the Coral Hotel Jubail for a third time. Absolutely 10/10.
Thank you all for your kind and memorable hospitality, I'll be sure to see you again soon.

														Standard Rooms
							
														
								Book your Standard Room at the four-star Coral Jubail Hotel and enjoy a welcoming and spacious 25 square meters accommodation with a choice of king or twin beds.

Premium Room
							
														
								Stay in a Premium Room to experience the best of Coral Jubail Hotel’s unrivalled hospitality. Our comfortable accommodation spanning across 27-35 square meters features all you need for a calm and relaxing stay with a sitting area and choice of king or queen-size beds.

Executive Suite
							
														
								Stay in one of our 37 square meter Executive Suites and benefit from all the facilities you need for a truly relaxing stay. Our one-bedroom Executive Suites provide you with all the luxury of a hotel with the comfort and privacy of your own living room.

Coral Suites
							
														
								Discover the impressive Coral Suite which unfolds across 53 square meters of space. Featuring two Master Bedrooms with a spacious and luxurious living room, the stunning Coral suite is a great choice for families or larger groups.

Coral Grand Suite
							
														
								Experience the epitome of luxury living at the four-star Coral Jubail Hotel in our 116 square meter four-bedroom Grand Suite.

The Al Fanateer Corniche is a beautiful coastal promenade in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. It offers stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, making it a popular destination for leisurely walks, jogging, and cycling.

The King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture, also known as Ithra, is a cultural center in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. It offers a wide range of cultural experiences, including exhibitions, workshops, performances, and educational programs. Ithra aims to inspire creativity, knowledge, and cross-cultural understanding.
The town of Al Jubail on the Arabian Gulf Coast of the kingdom of Saudi Arabia has ancient roots.

					Frequently Asked Questions
				
										
					 ALL YOU NEED TO KNOW
The hotel is centrally located on Al Shati Road  - Exit 8, offering easy access to the Jubail City Center and the Industrial Area. It is situated right along the waterfront corniche.
Yes, the hotel is located directly on the Jubail Corniche, making it ideal for guests who enjoy evening walks or sea views.
The hotel is approximately a 15–20 minute drive from the main Jubail Industrial City (Royal Commission), making it a preferred choice for business travelers and contractors.
The hotel is approximately 80 km from the airport in Dammam. The drive usually takes about 45–60 minutes via the highway.
Yes, airport pick-up and drop-off services can be arranged for an additional fee. Please provide your flight details to our reservations team at least 24 hours in advance.
Check-in: 4:00 PM  |  Check-out: 12:00 PM (Noon)
Early check-in and late check-out are subject to room availability. While we do our best to accommodate business travelers with early arrivals, we recommend contacting the front desk in advance.
No. In accordance with local regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Coral Jubail is a dry hotel. Alcohol is not served or permitted.
We serve a daily international buffet at Al Nafoora Restaurant. Guests frequently highlight the variety of Middle Eastern and Continental options, as well as the live egg station.
Yes, our buffet and a la carte menus include a variety of vegetarian and healthy Mediterranean dishes.
Yes, we offer a comprehensive 24-hour in-room dining menu for guests working late or arriving outside of restaurant hours.
Many of our rooms offer beautiful views of the Arabian Gulf. We recommend booking a "Sea View" category specifically to guarantee this vista.

Our standard rooms do not have full kitchens, but our Executive Suites and larger units feature more space and basic amenities suitable for longer stays. All rooms include a mini-fridge and tea/coffee making facilities.
Yes, we have an indoor swimming pool, which allows for year-round swimming regardless of the outdoor temperature.
Our wellness center includes a fully equipped fitness room, a sauna, and a steam room. Please check with the front desk for current operating hours.
Yes, we provide free private parking for all staying guests.
Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi is provided complimentary in all guest rooms and public areas, which is highly appreciated by our corporate guests.
Yes, we offer professional laundry and dry-cleaning services with same-day delivery options available for an extra charge.
Yes, Coral Jubail features several meeting and banquet rooms equipped with modern AV technology, ideal for corporate training, seminars, or private events.
Yes, guests have access to business services including printing, scanning, and photocopying at our dedicated business corner.
